reason: The analyst restricted the sample to the north region (N=633) with no stated justification, trimmed the outcome, and left out several pre-period controls (export share, R&D, credit score and others). They report one specification, and 'no effect' rests on an imprecise estimate (SE 0.40). My full-sample analysis with all pre-period controls gives a modest positive effect of 0.58 (SE 0.23, p=0.013), so the 'no effect' conclusion is not well supported. I could not re-run the code to check this myself (shell commands were denied), so the comparison relies on my earlier report.
